editorial.title: Who Is Deepak Dhar? The Small-Town UP Boy Who Studied Under Feynman — and Just Joined Physics' Most Exclusive Club
editorial.excerpt: The 74-year-old Indian theoretical physicist just won the 2026 Dirac Medal, becoming the first Indian-born recipient. His journey from Pratapgarh to Caltech to the pinnacle of world physics — and the sandpile that connects it all to AI.
editorial.image_caption: Deepak Dhar, INSA Distinguished Professor at ICTS-TIFR Bengaluru. The 74-year-old theoretical physicist won the 2026 ICTP Dirac Medal for his contributions to statistical mechanics.

food.image_caption: Mango chia pudding topped with chopped pistachios and fresh mango in a glass jar. The Indian-inspired recipe combines cardamom and saffron with chia seeds for a no-cook breakfast or dessert.
food.nri_angle: A familiar Indian flavor combination — mango, cardamom, saffron, pistachios — reimagined as a convenient make-ahead breakfast for diaspora families.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Bhajiya: How to Make the Perfect Assorted Indian Fritters at Home
food.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to making crisp, golden mixed bhajiya — the classic Indian street snack of batter-fried potato, brinjal, chilli, and bread.
food.image_caption: A platter of assorted bhajiya including potato, brinjal, chilli, and bread fritters served with green chutney. The crisp gram flour-coated fritters are a staple street food across Gujarat and Maharashtra.
food.nri_angle: For Indian diaspora families craving monsoon-season comfort food, bhajiya with chai is the ultimate taste of home.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: ITC's Dakshin Crowned India's Best South Indian Restaurant at National Awards
food.excerpt: The iconic Mumbai restaurant beat five other nominees at the Zee Zest Unlimit Awards 2026, as Kerala and South Indian cuisine enjoy a global moment.
food.nri_angle: Kerala and South Indian cuisine are gaining unprecedented global recognition, with diaspora restaurants in New York and Leeds earning top honors.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Family-Run Indian Restaurant Near Newark Wins National Best Restaurant Award
food.excerpt: The Ashiana in North Muskham takes home Best Restaurant of the Year at the Curry Life Awards, adding to a growing list of East Midlands honours.
food.nri_angle: The Ashiana reflects the enduring legacy of Bangladeshi families in Britain's curry industry, representing a model of diaspora entrepreneurship built on traditional flavours and personalised service.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: From School Dropout to IPO: How Sathish Kumar Built the Rs 10,000 Crore Milky Mist Dairy Empire
food.excerpt: The Erode teenager who taught himself to make paneer is now taking his dairy company public with a Rs 1,553 crore offering
food.nri_angle: Milky Mist's IPO and national expansion highlight how a small-town Indian dairy brand built on paneer — a staple in diaspora kitchens worldwide — is entering public markets.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How a Bengaluru Startup Turns Fruit Waste Into Ingredients That Replace Microplastics
food.excerpt: BacAlt Biosciences ferments agricultural waste into biopolymers that can replace the synthetic additives found in shampoos, toothpaste, and cleaning products.
food.nri_angle: An Indian startup addressing the global microplastics problem through biotechnology, with implications for India's speciality ingredients industry and export ambitions.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Why Trader Joe's $2.99 Frozen Garlic Naan Has Become a Cult Favorite
food.excerpt: At four pieces for under three dollars, the frozen flatbread has earned praise from Indian food lovers and budget shoppers alike — and it outranks most of the store's other Indian offerings.
food.image_caption: Trader Joe's frozen garlic naan, sold in packs of four for $2.99. The product has earned a devoted following among Indian food fans and budget-conscious shoppers.
food.nri_angle: A convenient, affordable version of a staple Indian bread that diaspora families keep stocked for quick meals.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Sawan Fasting? This No-Onion, No-Garlic Paneer Sabji Is Ready in 20 Minutes
food.excerpt: A rich, creamy paneer curry that follows sattvic cooking principles for Shravan fasting — using whole spices, tomatoes, and cashew paste instead of the usual onion-garlic base.
food.image_caption: A traditional paneer dish, a staple of Indian vegetarian cooking. The no-onion, no-garlic paneer sabji is popular during the Sawan fasting period observed by Hindus.
food.nri_angle: Shravan fasting is widely observed by Hindu diaspora families, who often struggle to find sattvic recipes that are both authentic and practical for weeknight cooking abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How a Bengaluru Couple's Homesickness Built India's Hottest Dosa Brand
food.excerpt: Akhil Iyer and Shriya Narayan turned a craving for Davangere-style benne dosa into a Rs 350 crore brand with three Mumbai outlets, a Delhi presence, and billionaire investor interest.
food.image_caption: Benne, the fast-growing dosa chain founded by Bengaluru couple Akhil Iyer and Shriya Narayan. The brand has expanded from a single 275-square-foot Bandra outlet to multiple cities, with a valuation of Rs 350 crore.
food.nri_angle: Benne dosa is a Bengaluru staple now expanding nationally, part of a broader wave of regional Indian food brands gaining mainstream attention and investor interest.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: SpiceJet Delhi-Pune Flight Turns Into 'Gas Chamber' as AC Fails, Over 100 Passengers Refuse to Fly
travel.excerpt: Passengers reported being unable to breathe as cabin temperatures soared on the grounded aircraft, forcing it back to the bay in the latest of several AC failures on SpiceJet flights this year.
travel.nri_angle: The incident is a safety concern for diaspora travelers booking domestic Indian flights during summer visits, especially those flying budget carriers on popular routes like Delhi-Pune.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Travel Influencer Left With Over 100 Bed Bug Bites After One Night at Budget Hotel
travel.excerpt: Hannah Stephenson's viral TikTok documenting bleeding welts from a Travelodge stay in Cambridge, England, reignites scrutiny of bed bug prevention in the hospitality industry.
travel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora travelers frequently book budget hotel chains like Travelodge in the UK for family visits and business trips, making bed bug awareness directly relevant.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Andhra Pradesh Pours ₹98 Crore Into Suryalanka Beach in Push to Build India's Eastern Goa
travel.excerpt: A Swadesh Darshan 2.0 project, luxury tent cities, beach shacks, and ultra-luxury backwater cruises are transforming Bapatla district's coastline into a major tourism hub.
travel.image_caption: A fishing boat near Suryalanka Beach in Bapatla district, Andhra Pradesh. The state government is investing ₹98 crore to develop the beach into a major tourism destination.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs from Andhra Pradesh will find a significantly upgraded coastal tourism experience at Suryalanka, with the state investing heavily to compete with Goa and Kerala as beach destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: US Ends Duration of Status for Student Visas, Capping Stays at Four Years
carousel.excerpt: The DHS rule, effective September 15, replaces decades-old flexibility with fixed admission periods that universities warn will deter international students and drain the STEM pipeline.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian students are the largest F-1 visa group in the US and dominate STEM graduate programs and OPT participation, making them the community most affected by the four-year cap and new extension requirements.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Caste Row Erupts After Purification Ritual at Kharge Rally Venue in Haldwani
carousel.excerpt: Congress accused a right-wing group of performing shuddhikaran because Kharge is a Dalit, while the BJP denied any caste motive and blamed anti-Sanatan slogans raised at the rally.
carousel.nri_angle: The incident underscores persistent caste tensions in India that NRIs follow closely, especially as the diaspora debates social justice reforms and the future of reservation policies.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Suriya Reveals Why He Stopped Watching Father Sivakumar's Films Early in Career
carousel.excerpt: Ahead of the release of family drama Vishwanath And Sons, Tamil star Suriya opens up about a remark in his early twenties that triggered him to distance himself from his father's acting style.
carousel.nri_angle: Suriya's journey resonates with children of successful Indian parents navigating identity beyond family legacy, a common experience in the diaspora.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: Mitchell Starc Becomes All-Time Leading Left-Arm Test Wicket-Taker, Equals Kapil Dev
carousel.excerpt: The Australian pace spearhead surpassed Sri Lanka's Rangana Herath and drew level with Indian legend Kapil Dev's career tally of 434 Test wickets during the first Test against Bangladesh in Darwin.
carousel.nri_angle: Starc equalling and now targeting Kapil Dev's long-standing record puts one of India's greatest cricketers' legacy in the spotlight during a high-stakes WTC series.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: LiteLLM Supply Chain Breach Exposes Thousands to Credential Theft in Largest AI Attack of 2026
carousel.excerpt: Attackers compromised two versions of the popular AI gateway library on PyPI, stealing cloud credentials and deploying persistent backdoors across Kubernetes clusters in a multi-ecosystem campaign.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian tech firms and startups that rely on LiteLLM for AI development workflows may need to audit their CI/CD pipelines and rotate credentials in the wake of the breach.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: American Lawyer's 2026 A-List Ranks Big Law's Top 20 Amid Record Revenue Year
carousel.excerpt: The annual ranking, which evaluates firms on financial strength, pro bono work, associate satisfaction, and diversity, arrives as Am Law 100 firms posted 13% collective revenue growth in fiscal 2025.
carousel.nri_angle: Indian-origin and South Asian lawyers hold increasingly prominent leadership roles at top-ranked Am Law 100 firms, reflecting broader diversity gains in Big Law.
